_comment: Site gazetteer: site_id -> name, district and WGS84 position. Gives FHIR
Location resources a `position` for the map layer.
Station names and reaches follow CPCB's National Water Quality Monitoring
Programme locations on the Yamuna and Ganga. COORDINATES ARE APPROXIMATE
and the readings in demo/timeseries/ are SYNTHETIC - this is demonstration
data shaped to be realistic, not observed measurement. Replace with the
real CPCB/state-PCB feed before presenting any of it as authoritative.
flow_km is distance downstream along that river from the first monitored station, APPROXIMATE and for ordering stations in a longitudinal profile. It is not a surveyed chainage.

yam-wazirabad.name: Yamuna at Wazirabad Barrage
yam-wazirabad.position_note: upstream reference — above the city's drains

yam-ito.name: Yamuna at ITO Bridge
yam-ito.reach: Yamuna — mid-city, downstream of Najafgarh drain

gan-jajmau.name: Ganga at Jajmau
gan-jajmau.reach: Ganga — downstream of Jajmau tannery cluster

mit-dharavi.name: Mithi at Dharavi outfall
mit-dharavi.reach: Mithi — tidal reach before Mahim Creek
